prompt: If the person who played the joker in "The Dark Knight" (2008) had children, how old will they be on the films 50th anniversary?
answer:
Heath Ledger’s daughter, Matilda Rose Ledger, was born on October 28, 2005. *The Dark Knight* was released on July 18, 2008, so its 50th anniversary will be July 18, 2058.

Matilda will be **52 years old** then.
